subject: Life Skills
title: Decoding Your Medical Bill
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Decoding Your Medical Bill.

hook.text: Hospital bills contain errors about 80% of the time, according to medical billing advocates.

buildup.text: Bills list procedure codes, not plain descriptions. A single code mismatch inflates charges dramatically.

discovery.text: An Explanation of Benefits from your insurer is not a bill. It shows what was covered and what you owe.

twist.text: Many charges are negotiable. Hospitals routinely reduce bills when patients simply ask for a review.

climax.text: Request an itemized bill. Compare it to your EOB and dispute any code you don't recognize.

punchline.text: Always request the itemized version. Errors hide in summaries.

quiz.question: What is the first thing you should request when reviewing a medical bill?
options: A payment plan from the hospital
An itemized bill to check each charge
A second opinion from another doctor
